task_message:
Case V08: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 231x231x121 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case V08 is complete. 

**Summary of the segmentation:**
- **Lesion:** large, lobulated, T2-hyperintense heterogeneous soft-tissue mass (vascular tumor) in the central soft tissues, best seen on axial slices ~5–66, with bright lobules separated by darker septa and internal signal voids.
- **Workflow:** Located the lesion with axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets, seeded it with positive points inside the bright core (v1), enclosed the full bright periphery with a lasso on axial 45 (v2), and added a positive prompt to capture the lateral heterogeneous component at axial 20 (v3, 103.6 mL).
- **Final review:** The mask follows the lesion boundary in all three planes; slices just past each end (axial 74, coronal 52/162, sagittal 70/152) are lesion-free, and the automatic candidates enclosing subcutaneous fat/skin were rejected.
- **Confidence:** medium (heterogeneous tumor with indistinct margins at its inferior aspect where it reaches the volume edge).
